counterexample: Set n=1012 and k=5. The right-hand side from step 0029 is 8(k-1)/(k-4)=8(5-1)/(5-4)=32, while 2n=2024. Thus 32<2024, not >2024. Even the displayed erroneous value 8×5=40 is still less than 2024.
assessment_summary: Steps 0001–0029 support the construction and the counting bound (for the relevant case k>4, using the convex extension noted in the proof). Step 0031 contains a definite false numerical statement, so the proof as written fails there. The intended argument is repairable: the right-hand side equals 32 at k=5 and decreases for k≥5, contradicting 2n=2024.
